newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BENFICA CAPTAIN PINTO SENT FROM FIELD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA CAPTAIN PINTO SENT FROM FIELD.

text.p: Benfica captain Joao Pinto was sent off in his club's 1-0 defeat away to Guimaraes on Sunday as Porto extended their commanding lead in the Portuguese first division with a crushing 5-0 win over Braga.

Porto, who appear unassailable in their bid for a third successive championship, top the table with 44 points, 11 ahead of Benfica. Sporting, who drew 2-2 against Belenenses on Friday, are in third place with 31 points.
Guimaraes captain Quim Berto scored a penalty after he was fouled in the eighth minute by Benfica's Belgian goalkeeper Michel Preud'homme.
Benfica went on the offensive but lost several opportunities to score. Swedish striker Martin Pringle hit the post in the 19th minute.

In the 69th minute Pinto, who on Friday signed a contract for life with Benfica, was sent off for arguing with the referee after demanding a penalty when he was brought down in the box by a Guimaraes defender.
Porto routed Braga at home as league top scorer Mario Jardel of Brazil scored two of his side's five goals.
Midfielder Zlatko Zahovic scored Porto's first goal with a shot inside the box in the 22nd minute. Jardel scored a second in a goalmouth scramble in the 33rd minute.
In the second half Braga were reduced to 10 men by the sending off of Sergio Abreu for fouling Zahovic.
In the 62nd minute Edmilson Pimenta scored from a rebound from Jardel after his penalty was deflected by Braga goalkeeper Rui Correia.
In the 64th minute Jardel scored his 15th of the championship, this time from a pass by Domingos Oliveira.
Substitute winger Antonio Folha scored the final goal in the 75th minute, surging up the field and scoring from inside the box.
